dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_password, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname, tu.user_email, tu.user_cell_phone, tu.user_home_phone, tu.user_last_login, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tbu.bu_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS bu_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tcc.cost_center_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS cost_center_name, tu.user_status, tu.user_source_id, tur.role_id, tr.role_title, tu.is_user_ldap_setting, ts.employee_code, tsq.security_question, tusq.answer, tsq.security_question_id, tu.force_password_change, tu.password_date_modified, tu.time_zone FROM tp_users tu LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (tu.user_source_id= ts.source_id) LEFT JOIN tp_user_business_unit tubu ON (tubu.user_id = tu.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_business_unit tbu ON (tubu.bu_id = tbu.bu_id) LEFT JOIN tp_user_cost_center tucc ON (tucc.user_id = tu.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_cost_center tcc ON (tucc.cost_center_id = tcc.cost_center_id) LEFT JOIN tp_user_security_question_answer tusq ON (tu.user_id = tusq.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_security_questions tsq ON (tusq.security_question_id = tsq.security_question_id), tp_user_roles tur, tp_roles tr WHERE tu.user_id = tur.user_id AND tur.role_id = tr.role_id AND tu.user_name=? GROUP BY user_id LIMIT 0, 1

GROUP BY candidate_id LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT tu.candidate_id, tu.candidate_user_name, tu.candidate_password, tu.candidate_first_name, tu.candidate_last_name, tu.candidate_email, tu.candidate_cell_phone, tcam.applicant_id FROM tp_onboarding_candidates tu LEFT JOIN tp_candidate_applicant_mapping tcam ON (tu.candidate_id= tcam.candidate_id) WHERE tu.candidate_id=? SELECT tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_password, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname, tu.user_email, tu.is_user_ldap_setting, tu.user_cell_phone, tu.user_home_phone, tu.user_last_login, tu.user_status, tu.user_source_id, CONCAT(user_fname,' ',user_lname) as name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tbu.bu_id) AS bu_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tcc.cost_center_id) AS cost_center_id, tur.role_id, tr.role_title, ts.employee_code, tu.dept_id, tu.sub_dept_id, tu.sub_sub_dept_id, tu.sub3_dept_id, tu.sub4_dept_id, tu.location_id, tu.grade_id, tu.band_id, tu.time_zone FROM tp_users tu LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (tu.user_source_id= ts.source_id) LEFT JOIN tp_user_business_unit tubu ON (tubu.user_id = tu.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_business_unit tbu ON (tubu.bu_id = tbu.bu_id) LEFT JOIN tp_user_cost_center tucc ON (tucc.user_id = tu.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_cost_center tcc ON (tucc.cost_center_id = tcc.cost_center_id), tp_user_roles tur, tp_roles tr WHERE tu.user_id = tur.user_id AND tur.role_id = tr.role_id AND tu.user_id=? GROUP BY user_id LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_password, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname, tu.user_email, tu.is_user_ldap_setting, tu.user_cell_phone, tu.user_home_phone, tu.user_last_login, tu.user_status, tu.user_source_id, CONCAT(user_fname,' ',user_lname) as name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tbu.bu_id) AS bu_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tcc.cost_center_id) AS cost_center_id, tur.role_id, tr.role_title, ts.employee_code, tu.dept_id, tu.sub_dept_id, tu.sub_sub_dept_id, tu.sub3_dept_id, tu.sub4_dept_id, tu.location_id, tu.grade_id, tu.band_id, tu.time_zone FROM tp_users tu LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (tu.user_source_id= ts.source_id) LEFT JOIN tp_user_business_unit tubu ON (tubu.user_id = tu.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_business_unit tbu ON (tubu.bu_id = tbu.bu_id) LEFT JOIN tp_user_cost_center tucc ON (tucc.user_id = tu.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_cost_center tcc ON (tucc.cost_center_id = tcc.cost_center_id), tp_user_roles tur, tp_roles tr WHERE tu.user_id = tur.user_id AND tur.role_id = tr.role_id AND tu.user_name=? INSERT INTO tp_positions (position_title, position_code, position_min_exp, position_max_exp, position_no_of_openings, position_current_openings, position_date_expiry, position_date_created, position_created_by, position_note, dept_id, degree_id,branch_id,position_status, position_requested_by,position_priority) values(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,now(),?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'1')

SELECT tp.position_id, tp.position_title, position_code, td.dept_name, tds.dept_name AS subDeptName, tdss.dept_name AS groupName, tbg.grade_name, GROUP_CONCAT(tl.location_name) AS locationName FROM tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON (td.dept_id=tp.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tds ON (tds.dept_id=tp.sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdss ON (tdss.dept_id=tp.sub_sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_grades tbg ON (tbg.grade_id=tp.grade_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tl.location_id=tpl.location_id) WHERE @@ @@ GROUP BY tp.position_id ORDER BY tp.position_title
SELECT distinct tp.position_id, tp.position_title FROM tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tp.position_id=tpl.position_id) WHERE tp.position_status= ? @@

select requirements from tp_positions where position_id =?

SELECT tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname, tr.role_title, ts.employee_code, tl.location_name, tdep.dept_name, tdeps.dept_name AS sub_dept, tdepss.dept_name AS sub_sub_dept, CONCAT(tu.user_fname,' ',tu.user_lname) as name FROM tp_users tu LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (ts.source_id=tu.USER_SOURCE_ID) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tl.location_id=tu.location_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdep ON (tu.dept_id=tdep.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdeps ON (tu.sub_dept_id=tdeps.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdepss ON (tu.sub_sub_dept_id=tdepss.dept_id) , tp_user_roles tur, tp_roles tr WHERE tr.role_id=tur.role_id AND tu.user_id=tur.user_id @@ AND tu.user_status=? GROUP BY tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname ORDER BY tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname

SELECT tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname, tr.role_title, CONCAT(tu.user_fname,' ',tu.user_lname) as name, td.dept_name as department, tds.dept_name as sub_department, tdss.dept_name as sub_sub_department, tl.location_name , ts.employee_code as employee_id FROM tp_users tu LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON( td.dept_id=tu.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tds ON( tds.dept_id=tu.sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdss ON( tdss.dept_id=tu.sub_sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tl.location_id = tu.location_id) LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (ts.source_id = tu.user_source_id), tp_user_roles tur, tp_roles tr WHERE tr.role_id=tur.role_id AND tu.user_id=tur.user_id @@ AND tu.user_status=? GROUP BY tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname ORDER BY tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname

SELECT * FROM( SELECT tp.position_id, tp.position_code, tp.position_title, tp.position_no_of_openings, tp.position_priority, tp.position_status, tp.position_type_ext_int, (SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps WHERE ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id AND ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id AND (tps.position_step_level=? OR tps.position_step_level=?) ) as candidates, (SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps WHERE ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id AND ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id AND tps.position_step_level=?) as offered, (SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicant_joining_history ta WHERE ta.position_id=tp.position_id) as joined, (SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE position_step_id_to IN (0,-4,-6,-7) ) AS tasp WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id )AS rejected, td.dept_name, tp.position_date_expiry , is_budget_committed @@ FROM tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_custom_field_values_position tvp ON (tp.position_id=tvp.entity_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id=tp.position_id) @@ , tp_departments td @@ WHERE tp.dept_id=td.dept_id AND tp.position_status != ? @@ GROUP BY tp.position_id ORDER BY tp.position_priority, tp.position_title ) AS pos @@

LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id=tp.position_id) WHERE tp.position_status != ? AND ((tp.position_status= ? AND tp.position_date_approved IS NULL) OR tp.position_status IN ('')) GROUP BY tp.position_id ORDER BY tp.position_priority, tp.position_title) AS pos

SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_city, ta.applicant_email1, ta.applicant_email2, ta.applicant_home_phone, ta.applicant_home_phone_is_invalid, ta.applicant_cell_phone, ta.applicant_cell_phone_is_invalid, ta.applicant_work_phone, ta.applicant_work_phone_is_invalid, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_position_id, ta.applicant_step_id, ta.vendor_id, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.source_id, ta.applicant_original_resume_path,ta.applicant_original_doc_path, ta.applicant_current_employer, ta.current_ctc, ta.expected_ctc, ta.applicant_joined, ta.applicant_date_joined, ta.applicant_notice_period, ta.date_of_birth, ta.passport_number, ta.resume_type_id, try.resume_type, ta.offered_ctc,ta.offered_basic,ta.applicant_level_offered, ta.applicant_designation_offered, ta.input_salary_variable, ta.applicant_status,ta.applicant_hrms_code, ts.source_title, tps.position_step_isscheduled, tps.position_step_level,ts.source_type_id,ta.joining_Bonus,ta.variable_Offered,ta.category,ta.sub_category,ta.user_id,ta.profile_pic_path FROM tp_applicants AS ta LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON(ta.applicant_position_id = tps.position_id AND tps.position_step_id = ta.applicant_step_id) LEFT JOIN tp_resume_types try ON (try.resume_type_id=ta.resume_type_id), tp_sources AS ts WHERE ta.source_id = ts.source_id AND ta.applicant_id=?

delete from tp_position_step_status_messages where status_message_id not in (@@) and position_step_id = ?
select version_number from tp_release_info order by rel_id desc limit 0, 1

SELECT tu.user_id, CONCAT(tu.user_fname,' ',tu.user_lname) as name FROM tp_user_permissions tup LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON (tu.user_id = tup.user_id) WHERE tup.permission_id IN (?) AND tu.user_status=? GROUP BY tu.user_id, tu.user_name, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname ORDER BY tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname
SELECT cast(user_id as char) FROM tp_users WHERE user_email = ?
SELECT column_property,column_dbname FROM tp_custom_report_columns WHERE column_dbname in (@@)
